column1: # World Development Indicators the World Bank adapter crawls: one request per indicator for all
# countries and aggregates. Curated per docs/roadmap/global-analysis.md
# `unit` becomes each series' units (the API's own `unit` field is almost always empty).
# Names and descriptions are not shipped here: the crawler fetches them from the World
# Bank's own /indicator/{id} endpoint on each crawl (see sources/world_bank.rs).
